_README: The 'arc of the war': named phases plus a dated timeline of discrete events. 'type' drives colour: escalation (red), deescalation (aqua), neutral (grey). Events are overlaid as markers on the Brent and US10Y charts so you can see the market react to the war in real time. Cowork should append events as they happen and advance 'current_phase' index.

phases.name: Latent
phases.blurb: Rhetoric and posturing; no direct fire.

phases.name: Kinetic onset
phases.blurb: First exchanges; launches ramp, strait contested.

phases.name: Peak intensity
phases.blurb: Blockade dynamics; transits collapse, interference peaks.

phases.name: De-escalation
phases.blurb: Launches fade, corridor reopens under escort, VLCCs prove it.

phases.name: Cessation
phases.blurb: Interference near-zero, transits normalised, ceasefire holds.

timeline.title: First direct exchange
timeline.note: Opening strikes; launch count breaks from baseline.

timeline.title: Tanker seizures begin
timeline.note: Interference incidents cross into double digits.

timeline.title: Peak launch week
timeline.note: Iranian launches top out; ability-to-hurt at maximum.

timeline.title: Escort convoys announced
timeline.note: Naval escort of merchant traffic begins.

timeline.title: First VLCC transit since onset
timeline.note: Corridor proven for the largest hulls.

timeline.title: Ceasefire framework
timeline.note: Launches into single digits; interference fading.

timeline.title: Transits back above 35/day
timeline.note: Strait functionally reopening; capacity failure confirmed in the data.
